command:
import os,sys,json
from pathlib import Path
from scripts.job import atomic,enable_subreaper
from benchmarks.programme import run_child
out=Path("{run}");record=dict(source=os.environ["TIDE_SOURCE_COMMIT"],physical_devices=os.environ.get("ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES"),state="running",children=[])
persist=lambda:atomic(out/"programme.json",record)
enable_subreaper()
for config,batch,length in (("settle",8,256),("timed",4,128)):
 for precision in ("fp32","bf16"):
  for label,devices,policy in (("single",["npu:0","npu:0"],"serial"),("dual_serial",["npu:0","npu:1"],"serial"),("dual_per_device",["npu:0","npu:1"],"per_device")):
   name=f"{config}-{precision}-{label}"
   command=[sys.executable,"-m","scripts.check_placement","--config","configs/hb-multiscale-x-"+config+".json","--devices",*devices,"--partition-kind","region","--region-concurrency",policy,"--transport","host_stage","--mode","train","--precision",precision,"--batch",str(batch),"--length",str(length),"--steps","6","--threads","4","--output",str(out/(name+".json"))]
   row=dict(identity=name,command=command,output=str(out/(name+".json")),log=str(out/(name+".log")),timeout_seconds=600,max_rss_bytes=80*2**30)
   record["children"].append(row);persist();run_child(row,persist,supervisor_pid=os.getpid())
record["state"]="completed" if all(r["state"]=="completed" for r in record["children"]) else "failed"
persist();sys.exit(record["state"]!="completed")

batches.note: before the subsequent public-device-context test was added

cpu_checks.environment: private .venv-instances, TORCH_DEVICE_BACKEND_AUTOLOAD=0, affinity80-87, OMP/MKL/OpenBLAS limits4; pytest tiny ATen threads1

boundaries.qualification: same-schedule reference/placed, gradients, three updates, split schedule and real restored update; qualification timings are not performance samples
boundaries.performance: one physical device / two serial devices / two per-device workers; all retain two identical logical shards; 6 real continued updates, cold index 0 separate and indices 1..5 as five non-IID samples
boundaries.timing: complete training includes zero_grad, preparation, forward/readout/necessary Timed flush/loss, backward, host-stage transport, AdamW, detach, all participating devices sync and intervening persisted stage-record IO
boundaries.exclusions: CPU construction, hashes, placement, optimizer/input setup, record_work replay, serial operator audit, finite/storage/update scans
boundaries.memory: per-step max_memory_allocated/max_memory_reserved, despite short field names; reserved may retain prior audit caches; supervisor RSS is sampled process-tree sum, separate from process ru_maxrss
boundaries.precision: FP32 parameters/gradients/master/AdamW; BF16 operator policy and KV payload; controls/SSD FP32, logical times int64
boundaries.instrumentation: per_device operator witness explicitly runs serial_region_audit; record_work runs requested scheduler; unknown caller dispatch/function modes are rejected, hooks/profilers do not propagate
boundaries.claim: no peer DMA/HCCL/replicas/CUDA hardware claim; finite deviations retained with original tolerances; later support/work differences prevent strict equivalent-trajectory speedup
